Starokostyantyniv New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Khmelnytskyi Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This is the newer of Starokostyantyniv's two Jewish cemeteries — its older counterpart, elsewhere in this collection, was demolished under Soviet rule, but this site remains operational today. Presumed to date to the mid-19th century, it first appears on a 1917 Russian map and had expanded by 1943; the neighboring Christian cemetery appears to have encroached on part of its original territory, and a Muslim grave sits between the two. It served the same community that peaked near 9,212 people in 1897 and was devastated during the 1941–1942 Nazi occupation and ghetto liquidation.
